description: This file defines the EmployeeSkill class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for handling filter fields related to employee skills in reporting. It extends a FilterField class and implements value normalization, providing methods to manipulate query builders and convert skill data to array format.

classes.name: EmployeeSkill
classes.description: A class for managing the employee skill filter field in report generation, enabling query modification and data serialization.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a condition to the query builder to filter by employee skill if the operator is EQUAL and the skill ID is set.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of aliases used for entities in the query, in this case, ['skill'].

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the skill ID stored in this filter to an array with its ID and name, if the skill exists.
